response.justification: Bogdan has exceptional technical depth, open-source contributions, and cross-stack experience, but lacks demonstrated leadership in IT architecture, UML modeling, and team management at an executive level, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical requirement for this client-facing role in Germany.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across languages, platforms, and DevOps infrastructure
Strong track record of mentoring and creating technical workshops
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic (C1 required)
No explicit evidence of UML modeling, IT architecture design, or requirements management experience
Lacks documented experience leading teams or managing client projects at an executive level
